title: Turnkey office renovation in Kyiv: how to plan it without stopping the business
seo_title: Turnkey Office Renovation in Kyiv: What to Plan
description: Turnkey office renovation in Kyiv: layout, meeting rooms, building services, working in a business centre, furniture. From $350/m² and how to stay on budget.
lead: An office is a tool that should work for your team and your clients. Here is how to plan a turnkey office renovation so you get a comfortable space, lose no working days and stay within the estimate.
photo_alt: White reception desk, document shelving and a green wall — completed Office Chicago project
body: h2
Start with the brief, not the wall colour
p

How many people will work here now and in a year, who needs quiet, where client meetings happen, whether you need a kitchen and a breakout area. The answers define the layout, and the layout defines the budget. Wall colours and furniture fronts are the last thing to discuss.
p
It helps to write a short brief before the first meeting with the designer. It saves time on approvals and lets you compare several layout options straight away.
ul
how many workstations you need today and how many for growth
which departments work together and which disturb each other
how often clients visit and where to receive them
which equipment needs its own space or power supply
what impression of the company a guest should get from the door
h2
What to build into an office layout
ul
open workstations and quiet offices
meeting rooms of different sizes — from a room for two to a presentation hall
kitchen, breakout area, cloakroom
a server room or network cabinet with its own cooling
spare sockets, network points and air conditioning for team growth
phone booths for calls and video meetings, so meeting rooms stay free
p

A good office layout solves three things: people do not disturb each other, routes are short, and the space can be reconfigured without another renovation. That is why we plan flexible zones and services with spare capacity.
p

Company image is a separate topic. Reception, the client meeting room and the corridor leading to it act as a business card. Brand colours, quality materials and well-designed lighting belong here, while in work areas comfort, quiet and order matter more.

h2
Building services: invisible but felt every day
p

Ventilation, air conditioning, lighting, acoustics and low-voltage networks affect productivity more than finishes do. A stuffy meeting room or a hum in the open space quickly becomes a problem for the whole team.
ul
fresh air supply, not just air conditioning
even lighting without glare on monitors
sound insulation for offices and meeting rooms, acoustic panels in the open space
structured cabling with spare ports
dedicated power circuits for the server room and kitchen
h2
Renovating without stopping work
p

The space can be split into phases, and noisy works moved to evenings and weekends. We agree the schedule with you and the business centre management. Building rules are clarified in advance: when materials can be delivered, which lifts to use, which works need a separate permit.
p
If the team is moving, we plan so that critical zones — workstations, network, server room — are ready first, while decor and finishing touches continue alongside normal work.
p
For you this means something simple: the team keeps working, clients visit as usual, and you see what has been done on site from the manager's reports — even if your head office is abroad.
h2
Furniture in parallel with the renovation
p

Furniture and lighting should be ordered right after the design is approved, so they arrive by the end of works. [Turnkey procurement](/en/turnkey-procurement) can be sourced directly from China, which costs less than buying locally. Desk, cabinet and partition sizes go into the drawings, so sockets and network points end up exactly where workstations will stand.
p

Storage is planned separately: document cabinets, personal lockers, a place for coats. When storage is not planned, boxes and folders quickly take over walkways and window sills, and a new office looks untidy.

h2
How much a turnkey office renovation costs
p

Turnkey office renovation at CAS Development starts from $350 per m². As a benchmark, a 200 m² office costs from $70,000 (200 × $350). This is only the starting rate: the exact amount comes from the estimate after measurements and design. If CAS carries out the renovation to our design, the final cost stays within ±5% of the estimate.
p

What is included is visible line by line in the estimate: demolition, building services, finishes, doors, lighting. Furniture and procurement can be put into a separate estimate, so you see where each part of the budget goes.
p
An example of a completed office with green walls is Office Chicago in our portfolio.
h2
Common office renovation mistakes
ul
planning exactly for today's headcount with no reserve
making every meeting room the same large size
forgetting acoustics in the open space
ordering furniture after the renovation and waiting for it in an empty office
not agreeing the works schedule with the business centre
h2
Checklist before you start
ol
brief: headcount, departments, ways of working
measured survey and check of building services
layout and interior design
estimate and works schedule agreed with the business centre
furniture and lighting ordered right after the design is approved
h2
How CAS works
p

We prepare the design, draw up a detailed estimate and run the project from demolition to furniture. You have one manager, regular photo and video reports and a 12-month warranty on works. We have completed 150+ projects since 2016. For international companies opening or moving an office in Kyiv, briefings and approvals can run online; invoices are issued for companies registered in Ukraine, and EU invoicing is being set up.
